renders: and the shared P6 strings (common.*) every guide, help, legal and 404 page loads
_meta.status: filled by P6. Keys are namespaced (common, deliveryPage, returnsPage) so they never collide with the delivery.* keys pricing.js reads from the copy store. No literal dates, £ amounts or percentages: dates, prices, cutoffs and exclusion lists are interpolated from rules, facts and pricing.js.

common.stuckBody: Ask the people who make the signs. A person reads every message and writes back.

deliveryPage.lede: Free, tracked delivery across mainland GB. Your sign arrives {lead} {from}, and you can check your postcode right here.

checker.empty: Type a postcode, for example SW1A 1AA.
checker.excludedBody: We’re working on it. Tell us where it’s going and we’ll be straight with you about what’s possible.
checker.askText: Hello, could you deliver a sign to {postcode}?

deliveryPage.ask: Ask us — we're working on it
deliveryPage.askText: Hello, could you deliver a sign to my postcode?

calc.counts: Approve on {day} before {cutoff} and that day counts.
calc.next: {day} isn’t a working day, or it’s past the cutoff, so the clock starts on {next}.

deliveryPage.holsNone: No more bank holidays are listed for this year yet.
deliveryPage.cra: This doesn't affect your rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015.

ready.body: Bought one of our designs as it is? Tell us within the window after it arrives and send it back in its box for a refund.

custom.big: Free to cancel until you approve your drawing
custom.body: Your words make it yours, so it can’t go back for a change of mind once we start making it. Before you approve the drawing you can cancel at no cost.

fault.body: Faulty, damaged or not what you approved? We repair or remake it. Send us a photo and we’ll take it from there.

returnsPage.contactTitle: Need to start a return or a claim?
returnsPage.contactBody: Send us your order reference and a photo or two. A person reads every message and sorts it out with you.
returnsPage.contactText: Hello, I need help with a return or a fault on my order.
returnsPage.statutory: Your statutory rights are not affected
